:::{#def-fold-out-rule}
#### Fold-out rule

For [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{j}$,
the **fold-out rule** $\fittedwo{j}{\cdot}$ is the prediction rule
that a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) produces
from the observations outside that fold:

$$
\set{(x_i, y_i) : i \notin \fold{j}} \mapsto \fittedwo{j}{\cdot}.
$$ {#eq-fold-out-rule}

:::
